protocol.interpretation: Analytic CPU64 normalization is an intermediate algebraic coordinate; captured native normalized outputs remain the reference. All contractions compact repeated heads at the same token. Conditional C/A radii are used only to explain errors, not to define a deployable candidate from evaluation masks.
